text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
I may not remember how many breads I've eaten in my life,
but I remember how many times we've smashed that sucker!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今まで食べたパンの枚数はおぼえてないけど、
あいつを倒した数はばっちりおぼえてるよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
We've shown it who's boss, but it's still raring to go.
In other words, our battle's only just beginning! I hope you're with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
結構倒したと思ったけど、
まだまだいけそうだね。
よぉし、
私たちの戦いはこれからだー！　
一緒に頑張ろうね！
